Round 1 — Define the ONE Thing

Before building anything, write the sentence: I want the board to leave this meeting having decided / committed to / introduced me to a specific thing. If you cannot write the sentence, the meeting is not ready.

Your Decisions

Trade-off: each extra ask covers another need, but splits the attention of the board and the time left to decide.
Boards punish surprise, not bad news. Pick which hard items you disclose early — delivered with a plan, most of these land well.
Decisions happen in pre-wires. Meetings ratify them.
Trade-off: too early and the call is forgotten or the news travels before the meeting; too late and directors have no time to form a view.
Trade-off: each core slide adds detail but takes time from the decision. Supporting detail can go in the appendix. If the core cannot carry the story, the story is not clear yet.
